caption: Same 314 natural proteins and selected structures, with structural contacts ranked by q_i × q_j. q is mean predicted lDDT over a residue's deposited heavy atoms, normalized to [0,1]. All ConFind degree>0 contacts are considered; eligible residues must be resolved in the frozen truth. Filter separation >=6 (all) or >=24 (long) before taking floor(input_L/5); unfilled ranks receive zero credit. Truth remains ConFind degree>=0.001, and never enters ranking. Stable (i,j) ties. MarinFold and Sequence KNN rankings are unchanged. Neff80 bins and equal-protein bootstrap intervals match the original comparison. Every selected contact and confidence traces through the contact-confidence CSV tables and the published pair-level archive. See CONTACT_CONFIDENCE.md.
